title: AU PS 1.0.0 Test Suite

children.title: AU PS Composition Mandatory Sections do not rely on emptyReason=nilknown
children.description: Warns when a mandatory section (Problems, Allergies, Medications) uses Composition.section.emptyReason = nilknown instead of an explicit negation code on the section's entry resource (e.g. AllergyIntolerance.code = 716186003 |No known allergy|). AU PS prefers the explicit-entry pattern used by FHIR, IPS and AU Core over emptyReason - this is a warning, not a failure.
